title: Allow re-running failed specialists after pipeline
author: madicen
body:
This PR introduces re-run functionality for failed specialists and PR agents post-pipeline, capturing RerunContext to enable manual re-execution without auto-cascading synthesis. Key changes include:

- **RerunContext Capture**: Added to Draft to store pipeline inputs for re-execution.
- **Review Package Helpers**: Extracted `RunSpecialistForDraft`, `RunPRAgentForDraft`, and `RunRepoArbiterForDraft` with support for RerunContext.
- **TUI Integration**: Implemented keyboard (`r`, `R`) and mouse controls for re-running agents, with soft summary banners when synthesis is stale.

Files impacted include `draft.go`, `rerun.go`, `runner.go`, and TUI components in `review` package.
